descriptionChirho: Qal: to shake or tremble, said of the earth, mountains, or people in response to God's power, fear, or catastrophic events.
Qal: to wave or sway back and forth, said of abundant fruit or grain rustling in the wind (Psalm 72:16).
Hifil causative: to make something tremble or shake, often with God as subject shaking the earth, heavens, or nations.
Hifil causative: to cause an animal to leap or bound, referring to the startling power that makes a horse spring forward (Job 39:20).
